snippet.title: Xploit Tower Defense - Reveal Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Xploit Tower Defense is an Mixed Reality experience that transforms your space into a virtual battlefield.
You are a human firewall — place turrets to slow down swarms of DDoS viruses and use your own body to destroy airborne Malworms.
Your NeuroGate has been hacked, and a digital breach has opened inside your room. Defend it at all costs, or you’ll lose connection with reality and be trapped in the Matrix forever.

Step into the cyber battlefield of Xploit Tower Defense, an intense MR Tower Defense for Meta Quest, where the line between your world and cyberspace begins to dissolve.

Play the demo today on Meta Store!
